Summarise the Checks on a Fitted Model

Source: R/check_fit_evidence.R
summary.RiskMap_check.Rd

Summary method for objects of class "RiskMap_check" from check_fit(). Where print() gives the verdict, summary() gives the evidence, the finding of each check in full with the numbers behind it, the certificate and the certification draws of each stage with the largest change in the estimates from the stage before, and the full results of the extra checks that ran. For the check of other maxima the numbers include, at each short scale of the screen, the log-likelihood estimated on the fitting draws and its exact lower bound, both above the estimate, and for a fit with the spatial variance at zero and a nugget the exact bound by scale and spatial share.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'RiskMap_check'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

An object of class "RiskMap_check".

...

other parameters.

Value

An object of class "summary.RiskMap_check", a list with the checks table, the results of the default and extra checks in the order of the table, the stages table with the column largest_move, and the draws, fit_seconds and not_computed of object.

See also

check_fit(), plot.RiskMap_check()

Examples

data(italy_sim)

fit <- glgpm(
  formula = y ~ gp(),
  data = italy_sim[1:100,],
  family = "gaussian",
  messages = FALSE
)

summary(check_fit(fit))
#> ── Evidence for the checks on this fit ─────────────────────────────────────────
#> 
#> ✔ Monte Carlo accuracy
#>   A Gaussian fit has no Monte Carlo error.
#>   Nothing recorded beyond the finding.
#> 
#> ℹ These checks concern the computation, not whether the model suits the data.
